Method of Attack: Embedding cryptocurrency mining code (Coinhive) to use device CPU for mining Monero (XMR) and other cryptocurrencies
Using Trojanized app to steal money from users' accounts
Limiting CPU usage to hide mining operation and prolong mining activity
Hosting mining scripts on own servers or via WebView component

Indicators of Compromise: Apps containing Coinhive cryptocurrency mining code
Apps embedding open-source mining tool XMRig
Mining scripts loaded via WebView component
Trojanized app stealing over 10,000 euros from users
